title: Artificer
contents: text | A magical inventor and crafter, the Artificer blends arcane knowledge with mechanical genius. They infuse mundane objects with magical power, crafting tools, potions, and gadgets that reshape the battlefield.
bullet | Hit Dice: 1d8 per Artificer level
bullet | Armor: Light Armor, Medium Armor, Shields
bullet | Tools: Thieves' Tools, Tinker's Tools, one type of Artisan's Tools
bullet | Skills: Choose 2 from Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Sleight of Hand

title: Artificer Levels Progression
contents: bullet | Lvl2: Replicate Magic Item (4 plans), 1 item
bullet | Lvl3: Subclass, Right Tool for the Job

title: Magical Tinkering
contents: text | Since Level 1, as an Action while holding Tinker's Tools, you can conjure one basic item in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. The item lasts for 1 hour.
text | You can do this a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.

text | Ball Bearings, Basket, Bedroll, Bell, Blanket, Block and Tackle, Bucket, Caltrops, Candle, Crowbar, Flask, Jug, Lamp, Net, Oil, Paper, Parchment, Pole, Pouch, Rope, Sack, Shovel, String, Tinderbox, Torch, Vial

title: Spellcasting (1/2)
contents: text | You channel magic through your tools, crafting spells instead of casting them in the traditional way.
text | Use Thieves' Tools, Tinker's Tools, or any Artisan's Tools you're proficient with as your Spellcasting Focus. You must be holding it to cast spells with an M component.
text | Know 2 cantrips from the Artificer list.
text | After a Long Rest, you may swap 1 for another.
text | At levels 10 and 14, you learn an additional cantrip.

title: Spellcasting (2/2)
contents: text | Use Intelligence for spell attack rolls and saving throw DCs.
text | Prepare Intelligence modifier + Artificer level spells (minimum 1).
text | Choose from the Artificer list. Cure Wounds and Grease are recommended.
text | As a half caster, you gain spell slots more slowly than full casters.
text | All slots are regained after a Long Rest.
text | If you multiclass, treat each level in Artificer as ½ level (rounded up) when calculating your total caster level for determining spell slots. Add this to your full caster levels.

title: Replicate Magic Item
contents: text | You learn arcane plans that let you craft magic items at the end of a Long Rest using Tinker's Tools.
text | • Choose 4 magic item plans when you gain this feature
text | • Create 1–2 items after a Long Rest (must be different)
text | • Must be items you have plans for
text | • If item requires attunement, you can attune during creation
text | • Items vanish when you die or exceed your item limit
text | Items replicate real magic items but are not permanent
text | • They vanish 1d4 days after your death
text | • Contents of containers (like Bag of Holding) reappear safely
text | • Learn additional plans as you level up
text | • Swap 1 plan when you gain a level

title: Soul of Artifice
contents: text | Cheat Death: When dropped to 0 HP, disintegrate a replicated Uncommon/Rare item to instead return to 20 HP.
text | Magical Guidance: While attuned to at least 1 item, add 1d6 to any ability check once per turn.

title: Right Tool for the Job
contents: text | Since Level 3, Magical Tinkering can now create any set of Artisan's Tools instantly, using your tools and creativity.

title: Magic Item Tinker
contents: text | Since Level 6, Drain Magic Item (Bonus Action): Touch a Replicate Magic Item you created within 5 ft and dismiss it to gain a temporary spell slot.
text | • Common item → 1st-level spell slot
text | • Uncommon/Rare item → 2nd-level spell slot
text | Limit: 1 use per Long Rest. Slot expires at next Long Rest.
text | Expanded Replication: You can now learn plans for Uncommon items (e.g. Armor +1, Boots of Elvenkind, Eyes of Charming).

title: Drain Magic Item
contents: text | Bonus Action: Touch a Replicated Magic Item within 5 ft and dismiss it to convert its energy into a temporary spell slot.
text | • Common item → 1st-level spell slot
text | • Uncommon or Rare item → 2nd-level spell slot
text | Expiration: Slot vanishes at end of next Long Rest

title: Flash of Genius
contents: text | When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet fails an Ability Check or a Saving Throw, you can use your Reaction to add a bonus to the roll.
text | The bonus equals your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1).
text | You can decide to use this feature after seeing the roll, but before its outcome is determined.
text | You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once).
text | You regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

title: Magic Item Adept
contents: text | You have achieved a profound mastery over magical craftsmanship, allowing you to handle more magic items and craft them with greater efficiency.
text | You can now attune to up to 4 magic items at once, rather than the usual limit of 3.
text | When using Replicate Magic Item to craft a Common or Uncommon item:
bullet | The crafting time is reduced to ¼ of the standard time.
bullet | The gold cost is reduced to ½ of the standard cost.

title: Spell-Storing Item
contents: text | Store magical power inside a weapon or focus, allowing others to cast a spell you infused.
text | After a Long Rest, touch a Simple/Martial weapon or Spellcasting Focus.
text | Choose a 1st–3rd level Artificer spell with 1 Action casting time (need not be prepared).
text | That spell is stored in the object.
text | A creature holding it may use an Action to cast the spell, using your spellcasting ability modifier. It must Concentrate if required.
bullet | Recharge: After each Long Rest
bullet | Storing a new spell replaces the old one, even if unused
text | The spell remains until expended / replaced.

title: Magic Item Savant
contents: text | You've honed your expertise with magic items, enhancing your attunement capacity and unlocking rare replications.
text | You can attune to up to 5 magic items simultaneously.
text | When choosing plans for your Replicate Magic Item feature, you can now select from the Rare magic item list.
text | You may have up to 3 Rare replicated items active at the same time.

title: Magic Item Master
contents: text | At the peak of your craft, your affinity for magic items becomes unmatched.
text | You can now attune to up to six magic items simultaneously, instead of the usual limit of three.
text | This exceptional capacity allows you to wield and benefit from more magical effects than any other adventurer.
text | Only one item may be attuned per Short Rest, as normal, but your total attuned capacity increases to six.
text | You are still bound by all other standard attunement rules.

title: Ability Score Improvement
contents: subtitle | Levels 4, 8, 12 & 16
text | At these levels, you gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or a feat of your choice.
bullet | Increase one ability by +2 OR two abilities by +1 each.
bullet | You can't raise an ability above 20 with this feature.
text | Consider whether boosting your spellcasting stat or picking up a versatile feat better suits your current role.

title: Epic Boon
contents: text | Gain the Epic Boon feat, or another feat of your choice.
text | Epic Boons are powerful late-game feats, exclusive to tier 4 adventurers.
text | They often grant strong passive effects or abilities beyond standard limits.
bullet | Boon of Energy Resistance — reduce elemental damage.
bullet | Boon of Fortitude — +40 max HP.
bullet | Boon of High Magic — gain a 9th-level slot.
bullet | No ability can exceed 20 unless explicitly allowed.

title: Multiclass Note
contents: text | When multiclassing, add ½ your Artificer levels (round up) to your full-caster levels to determine total spell slots.
text | Example: Fighter 3 / Artificer 5 counts as Full Caster L = 5 (3 + ⌈5÷2⌉).
